affectedRegressionRun.note: Native plan review-token failure repaired and rechecked in the final bundled suite.

bundled.scope: Bundled Electron in Node mode; isolated RDX cloud, native plan pullback, conflict/recovery and authority checks

mapUI.scope: Isolated desktop assets in headless Chromium, not the installed Electron application
checks: Offline empty workspace exposes local RDX import and dependency preview
Confirmed import opens the map through the existing NPCDex renderer
Original contextual note and flag controls save into the managed RDX
Current map export downloads a verified portable RDX with the UI edits
Update preview remains scrollable above its fixed actions at 620px height
Shared-context conflict blocks confirmation until an explicit choice, and retains newer local notes
A padded publication preview requires explicit binding and preserves Auto-Sync Off
Native title evidence is reviewed through an explicit choice without replacing local notes
No browser runtime errors or external network access

planUI.scope: Actual plan dialog module and styles in isolated headless Chromium; no installed native-window acceptance
checks: Import previews and saves locally without queuing native operations
Local task editor preserves names and exact notes
Verified RDX export includes local edits without backend bindings
Tier rebasing is visible and publication waits for explicit assignee mapping
Short-window preview scrolls above its separate action footer
Explicit existing-task matching previews conflicts and queues an edit instead of a duplicate create
Explicit queue preserves Auto-Sync Off and exposes durable batch progress
No browser runtime errors or external network requests

serviceSmoke.scope: Actual desktop-service RPC with disposable offline profile
checks: Offline import
Shared Data/RDX ownership
Unchanged NPCDex selection
Lifecycle suspension/resume
Checkpoint/shutdown
Store ownership released

liveProof.scope: Actual NPCD round trip with unique fictional RDX data
checks: A real compressed RDX imports and binds only after a fresh preview
Private NPCD record tree and exact artifact/image attachments read back
A local NPCDex note reaches the verified backend commit
An independent native YouTrack title change enters review and is accepted into the managed RDX
Reopen and portable export retain the local note, accepted native title and exact original image bytes
A separate local instance matches the observed registry and downloads both changes without duplicating content records
liveProof.cleanup: Retained private, uniquely marked QA records and a portable test RDX for review; no production records edited

finalLiveProof.scope: Final source in Windows/Electron against the existing isolated QA tree

postLiveGuard.description: Native-review approval additionally pins the local document head, preventing a later local edit from being overwritten. Normal and stale-review paths passed focused checks; the final 25-case bundled suite passed. No further live writes were needed for this guard.

limits: UI evidence is isolated desktop assets in Chromium, not installed native-window acceptance
Shared context/native pin mismatches need coordinated review
Current production NPCD identities must be adopted explicitly under RD10
No agent dispatch, returned-result reconciliation or human-testing completion enabled
